from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal

import pytest

from ledgerly import audit
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError
from ledgerly.invoice import invoice_total, issue_invoice
from ledgerly.models import Invoice, LineItem, Subscription
from ledgerly.payments import authorize
from ledgerly.subscriptions import current_period

T0 = datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)


def make_invoice():
    return Invoice(
        id="inv_1",
        customer_id="cus_1",
        lines=[LineItem("Seat", 3, Decimal("19.99")), LineItem("Setup", 1, Decimal("50.00"))],
    )


def test_invoice_total():
    assert invoice_total(make_invoice()) == Decimal("109.97")


def test_issue_invoice_records_audit():
    inv = issue_invoice(make_invoice(), T0)
    assert inv.status == "issued"
    assert audit.events("invoice_issued")[0]["invoice_id"] == "inv_1"


def test_issue_empty_invoice_fails():
    with pytest.raises(BillingError):
        issue_invoice(Invoice(id="inv_2", customer_id="cus_1"), T0)


def test_authorize_payment():
    inv = issue_invoice(make_invoice(), T0)
    payment = authorize("pay_1", inv, "109.97", T0)
    assert payment.amount == Decimal("109.97")
    assert payment.status == "authorized"


def test_current_period():
    sub = Subscription("sub_1", "cus_1", Decimal("30.00"), 30, T0)
    start, end = current_period(sub, datetime(2026, 2, 5, tzinfo=timezone.utc))
    assert start == datetime(2026, 1, 31, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    assert end == datetime(2026, 3, 2, tzinfo=timezone.utc)

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly import audit
from ledgerly.adjustments import refund_shipping
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError

T0 = datetime(2026,1,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
audit.clear()

# idempotency: same record, no double apply
p = Payment("p1","i1",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured")
r1 = refund_shipping(p, Decimal("10.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k1")
r2 = refund_shipping(p, Decimal("10.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k1")
assert r1 is p and r2 is p
assert p.refunded_amount == Decimal("10.00"), p.refunded_amount
assert len(audit.events("shipping_refunded")) == 1
assert audit.events("shipping_refunded")[0]["idempotency_key"] == "k1"

# approval required above 500
p2 = Payment("p2","i2",Decimal("1000.00"),status="captured")
try:
    refund_shipping(p2, Decimal("500.01"), T0)
    raise AssertionError("should require approval")
except BillingError as e:
    assert e.code == "approval_required"
# at threshold no approval
refund_shipping(p2, Decimal("500.00"), T0)
assert p2.refunded_amount == Decimal("500.00")
# with approval
refund_shipping(p2, Decimal("500.00"), T0, approved_by="mgr")
assert p2.status == "refunded"

# idempotency checked before validation: invalid state but existing key returns record
p3 = Payment("p3","i3",Decimal("100.00"),status="voided")
refund_shipping(p3, Decimal("10.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k3") if False else None
# create a keyed entry via valid payment then reuse key on voided
p4 = Payment("p4","i4",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured")
refund_shipping(p4, Decimal("10.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k4")
assert refund_shipping(p3, Decimal("10.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k4") is p3

# exceeds captured
p5 = Payment("p5","i5",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured")
try:
    refund_shipping(p5, Decimal("100.01"), T0)
    raise AssertionError
except BillingError as e:
    assert e.code == "refund_exceeds_captured"
print("all edge cases OK")
EOF"}

from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly import audit
from ledgerly.adjustments import refund_shipping
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError

T0 = datetime(2026,1,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
audit.clear()

# idempotency: same record, no double apply
p = Payment("p1","i1",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured")
r1 = refund_shipping(p, Decimal("10.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k1")
r2 = refund_shipping(p, Decimal("10.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k1")
assert r1 is p and r2 is p
assert p.refunded_amount == Decimal("10.00"), p.refunded_amount

refund_shipping(p2, Decimal("500.00"), T0, approved_by="mgr")

# idempotency checked before validation: invalid state but existing key returns record
p3 = Payment("p3","i3",Decimal("100.00"),status="voided")
refund_shipping(p3, Decimal("10.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k3") if False else None
# create a keyed entry via valid payment then reuse key on voided
p4 = Payment("p4","i4",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured")
refund_shipping(p4, Decimal("10.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k4")
assert refund_shipping(p3, Decimal("10.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k4") is p3

# exceeds captured
p5 = Payment("p5","i5",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured")
try:
    refund_shipping(p5, Decimal("100.01"), T0)
    raise AssertionError
except BillingError as e:
    assert e.code == "refund_exceeds_captured"
print("all edge cases OK")
EOF
